requirements.title: Binary and decimal rounding modes apply by operation radix
requirements.source: S17.4 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: The document specifies separate binary and decimal rounding modes affecting radix-two and radix-ten floating-point arithmetic; unqualified rounding-mode references for operations refer to the operation radix and other references to both modes.

pending.binary-rounding-mode-affects-radix-two-a: Guard probe: profiled real kind X has RADIX(X)==2 and supports IEEE_UP plus IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: set each mode around volatile 1.0_X + EPSILON(1.0_X)/2.0_X and assert directed binary results differ as specified by S17.4-002. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.decimal-rounding-mode-affects-radix-ten-: Guard probe: profiled real kind X has RADIX(X)==10 and supports IEEE_UP plus IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: repeat the directed half-ulp addition for decimal X. FALSE branch: skip absent decimal support.
pending.unqualified-rounding-mode-reference-sele: Guard probe: one binary and one decimal supported kind are present. TRUE branch: setting the unqualified mode form is checked with GET for both radix modes, then each kind uses its own mode in the directed operation. FALSE branch: skip missing radix branch.

requirements.title: IEEE rounding constants correspond to 60559 attributes and IEEE_OTHER is processor dependent
requirements.source: S17.4 p2.rounding-attribute-mapping, p2.ieee-other-latitude; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, IEEE_DOWN, and IEEE_AWAY correspond respectively to roundTiesToEven, roundTowardZero, roundTowardPositive, roundTowardNegative, and roundTiesToAway; IEEE_OTHER has no 60559 rounding-direction attribute and has processor-dependent effect if supported.

pending.ieee-nearest-ties-to-even-half-ulp-resul: Guard probe: radix-two kind X supports IEEE_NEAREST. TRUE branch: set mode, compute volatile 1.0_X + EPSILON(1.0_X)/2.0_X, assert result equals 1.0_X because the even significand endpoint is chosen. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.ieee-to-zero-directed-half-ulp-result: Guard probe: radix-two kind X supports IEEE_TO_ZERO. TRUE branch: positive half-ulp addition rounds to 1.0_X and negative -1.0_X - EPSILON/2.0_X rounds to -1.0_X. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.ieee-up-directed-half-ulp-result: Guard probe: radix-two kind X supports IEEE_UP. TRUE branch: positive half-ulp addition yields 1.0_X + EPSILON(1.0_X), while negative half-ulp addition yields -1.0_X. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.ieee-down-directed-half-ulp-result: Guard probe: radix-two kind X supports IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: positive half-ulp addition yields 1.0_X, while negative half-ulp addition yields -1.0_X - EPSILON(1.0_X). FALSE branch: skip.
pending.ieee-away-ties-to-away-half-ulp-result: Guard probe: kind X supports IEEE_AWAY. TRUE branch: half-ulp ties on +1.0_X and -1.0_X round away from zero to adjacent representable values. FALSE branch: skip unsupported mode.
pending.ieee-other-effect-processor-dependent: No portable oracle fixes the arithmetic effect of IEEE_OTHER; fixtures may only assert set/get round-trip on processors reporting IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_OTHER,X).

requirements.title: IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE retrieves rounding modes and initial modes are processor dependent
requirements.source: S17.4 p3.get-rounding, p3.initial-latitude; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE gets the rounding modes; the initial rounding modes are processor dependent.

pending.ieee-get-rounding-mode-retrieves-current: Guard probe: kind X supports IEEE_UP and IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: set IEEE_UP, initialize result to IEEE_DOWN, call IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE, and assert result == IEEE_UP; repeat reversed. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.initial-rounding-modes-processor-depende: No portable oracle requires an initial rounding mode; fixtures save the initial mode for restoration and do not compare it to a named constant.

requirements.title: IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE alters supported rounding modes
requirements.source: S17.4 p4; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: On processors that support alteration of rounding modes during execution, IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE can alter them.

pending.ieee-set-rounding-mode-alters-supported-: Guard probe: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING reports true for two distinct modes on kind X. TRUE branch: set first mode and GET observes it, set second mode and GET observes it; restore saved mode. FALSE branch: skip alteration test.

requirements.title: Procedures preserve rounding modes on entry and restore them on return
requirements.source: S17.4 p5; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: In a procedure other than IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE or IEEE_SET_STATUS, the processor does not change rounding modes on entry and ensures they are the same on return as on entry.

pending.rounding-mode-unchanged-on-procedure-ent: Guard probe: kind X supports IEEE_UP and IEEE_DOWN; caller sets IEEE_UP then calls helper. TRUE branch: helper first GET returns IEEE_UP before any setter call. FALSE branch: skip.
pending.rounding-mode-restored-on-procedure-retu: Guard probe: same helper then sets IEEE_DOWN internally, calls IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE before return, and confirms IEEE_DOWN was the changed in-helper value. TRUE branch: caller GET returns original IEEE_UP after return, then caller restores saved initial mode. FALSE branch: skip.
